QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_23

question.text: The Social Project Monitoring Framework used in SIA engagements typically applies the methodology of:

answer.text: Theory of Change or Logical Framework Approach, mapping inputs → activities → outputs → outcomes → impact

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.9.3 states: 'Social projects apply the methodology of Theory of Change or the Logical Framework Approach when designing social projects. These methodologies map out how and why a desired change is expected to happen in a particular context.' The Project Monitoring Framework details inputs, activities, outputs, outcomes, and impact. The Trap: CAPM (A), Black-Scholes (C), and EV/EBITDA (B) are all financial-economic models — no bearing on SIA monitoring frameworks.
